company.name: Intryc
company.shortDescription: Intryc employs artificial intelligence to automate the quality assurance process for customer support services.
company.description: Consumer enterprises have millions of customer support tickets annually. They need to constantly evaluate support agents’ performance and compliance. Typically they evaluate less than 5% of those interactions manually which is slow, expensive and not scalable. Intryc's AI can evaluate 100% of all customer interactions, in real time, at half the cost.

productsAndServices.description: Automates the quality assurance process for customer support by evaluating 100% of support tickets using AI, enabling consistent and comprehensive performance reviews.
productsAndServices.name: AI-Powered Quality Assurance Automation

productsAndServices.description: Allows organizations to create unlimited custom scorecards and criteria tailored to their specific customer support quality standards and evaluation needs.
productsAndServices.name: Customizable Scorecards and Evaluation Criteria

productsAndServices.description: Provides automated, rule-based sampling of support tickets and dynamic workload distribution to ensure comprehensive and statistically significant QA coverage.
productsAndServices.name: Intelligent Sampling and Workload Management

productsAndServices.description: Delivers AI-driven analytics and real-time alerts on customer support performance, highlighting key issues, trends, and agent coaching opportunities.
productsAndServices.name: Real-Time Performance Analytics and Insights

productsAndServices.description: Supports tailored coaching for support agents based on evaluation results and provides context-rich analysis to fairly resolve evaluation disputes.
productsAndServices.name: Agent Coaching and Dispute Resolution Tools
